mcq_data.question: The two broad categories of software are __________.
mcq_data.solution: Software is broadly classified into system software and application software.

mcq_data.question: Word processing, spreadsheet and photo-editing are examples of __________.
mcq_data.solution: These programs are designed to perform user-specific tasks, hence they are application software.

mcq_data.question: __________ is a set of computer programs used on a computer to help perform tasks.
mcq_data.solution: Software is a collection of programs that instruct a computer to perform tasks.

mcq_data.question: Linux is an __________ operating system.
mcq_data.solution: Linux is an open-source operating system whose source code is freely available.

mcq_data.question: An __________ uses pictures (called icons) and menus displayed on the screen to send commands to the computer system.
mcq_data.solution: GUI (Graphical User Interface) allows users to interact using icons and menus.

mcq_data.question: Which of the following statement is wrong?
options: Windows XP is an operating system
Linux is owned and sold by Microsoft
Photoshop is a graphical design tool by Adobe
Linux is free and open source software
mcq_data.solution: Linux is not owned or sold by Microsoft; it is open source.

mcq_data.question: Software such as viruses, worms and Trojan horses that has a malicious intent is known as __________.
mcq_data.solution: Malware is software designed to harm or exploit computer systems.

mcq_data.question: __________ are viruses that are triggered by the passage of time or on a certain date.
mcq_data.solution: Time bombs activate on a specific date or time.

mcq_data.question: Operating system of a computer __________.
options: Enables the programmer to draw a flow chart
Links a program with subroutine with references
Provides a layer, user friendly interface
mcq_data.solution: The operating system provides a user-friendly interface between user and hardware.

mcq_data.question: The term 'Operating System' means __________.
options: A set of programs which control computer working
The way a user operates the computer system
Conversion of high level language to machine language
mcq_data.solution: An operating system controls and manages the overall functioning of a computer.

mcq_data.question: The startup routine that runs when a machine boots up is known as __________.
mcq_data.solution: POST (Power-On Self Test) runs when the computer starts.

mcq_data.question: Operating system is also known as __________.
mcq_data.solution: An operating system is classified as system software.

mcq_data.question: Which statement is valid about interpreter?
options: It translates one instruction at a time
Object code is saved for future use
mcq_data.solution: An interpreter translates and executes one instruction at a time.

mcq_data.question: What is a compiler?
options: A compiler does a conversion line by line as the program is run
A compiler converts the whole of a higher level program code into machine code in one step
A compiler is a general purpose language providing very efficient execution
mcq_data.solution: A compiler translates the entire program into machine code at once.

mcq_data.question: Which of the following is not an operating system?
mcq_data.solution: Oracle is a database software, not an operating system.

mcq_data.question: Linux is a(n) __________ operating system.
mcq_data.solution: Linux is an open-source operating system.

mcq_data.question: Which of the following is not a multitasking operating system?
Which of the following is system software?
mcq_data.solution: Operating systems, compilers, and utilities are all system software.

mcq_data.question: The primary purpose of an operating system is __________.
options: To make the most efficient use of the computer hardware
To allow people to use the computer
To make computers easier to use
mcq_data.solution: The main goal of an operating system is efficient utilization of hardware resources.
